release_notes: Security release (independent audit of v1.5.15). Fixes account takeover through profile_settings, role checks on every settings and admin action (default-deny for the user role), the IP allowlist, Telegram bot access (secret-checked webhook, chats join only with a one-time code from the panel), stopped/archived campaigns taking traffic, geo filters and TLS for geo downloads, lost clicks under database locks (file spool), Keitaro import mapping, and adds optional TOTP two-factor login and HMAC for /crm-ingest. IMPORTANT for servers installed before 1.6.0: after updating, the panel shows a one-time SSH command (cli/server_setup.sh) that replaces the old sudo rules through which the web user could become root. The Update button cannot do this step itself - please run the command once.
